title: Self-Pay Visit Package Terms — Lapsed Packages and Reinstatement
content:
**Lapsed packages.** Whether an expired Self-Pay Visit Package can be reinstated, how long after expiry, at what fee and for how many further days, is fixed by its tier.

| Tier | Reinstatement window after expiry | Reinstatement fee | Days added to the expiry date, counted from the reinstatement date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | 0 calendar days (not offered) | $0.00 | 0 |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | 0 calendar days (not offered) | $0.00 | 0 |
| Core 8-Visit Package | 30 calendar days | $35.00 | 30 |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | 30 calendar days | $35.00 | 30 |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | 30 calendar days | $35.00 | 30 |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | 30 calendar days | $50.00 | 45 |

**Definitions**

- *Reinstatement window* — the calendar days after expiry within which an expired package may be reinstated; 0 where reinstatement is not offered.
- *Reinstatement fee* — the fee to reinstate an expired package; $0.00 where reinstatement is not offered.
- *Days added* — the calendar days added to the expiry date, counted from the reinstatement date, when a package is reinstated; 0 where reinstatement is not offered.

*Hypothetical reading:* a Comprehensive 24-Visit Package reinstated on a given day receives a new expiry date 45 calendar days after that day; a Core 8-Visit Package reinstated on the same day receives one 30 calendar days after it.
